newsitem.title: USA: SEC to extend broker recordkeeping comment period.
newsitem.headline: SEC to extend broker recordkeeping comment period.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said Tuesday it extended the public comment period to March 31 from December 27 on amendments to its rules governing broker-dealer books and recordkeeping.

The comment period has been extended to give the SEC time to consider the views of all interested parties including the National Association of Securities Dealers Regulation and the New York Stock Exchange.

Amendments to the rules, first proposed on October 22, include a call for clarification, modification and expansion of recordkeeping requirments with respect to the buying and selling of documents and customer records.
The proposals are also intended to obligate broker-dealers to make records available to state regulators during examination and enforcement proceedings.

In a letter to the SEC, a securities industry group asked the regulatory agency to consider withdrawing the proposed amendements, saying existing rules have served the industry well for over 50 years.
